name: Trenmaxxrr Hacks
description: Custom hacks, each one toggleable in this mod's settings.

show-menu-button.name: Show menu button
show-menu-button.description: Adds a button to the main menu that confirms the mod is loaded.

input-buffer.name: Input buffer (F6)
input-buffer.description: Lets F6 cycle the input buffer in levels: off, 2, 4, 8, 16 ticks (wave capped at 8). It predicts your path with GD's own physics and shifts the timing of your clicks and releases (never moves your player): holds back inputs that would crash you, and on wave/ship switches early when you're about to crash, waiting for your input to catch up. Not in platformer or vertical sections. It starts off every time you open GD, and an on-screen label always shows while it's on.
